# IntentProbe

> CPU activation probes for AI-agent guardrails and classification.

IntentProbe shares one frozen local language model forward pass across independently trained
activation heads. A hosted agent uses a separate CPU sidecar; its hidden states are not accessed.
The measured 16-head runtime is research code. The shipped package is the tool-poisoning scanner;
authorization and memory-write probes have standalone scorers. General hot-loading is specified work.

Author: ithiria894. Publisher: MCPware, a product and research brand of GEASS LABS INC.

- Architecture: https://mcpware.github.io/IntentProbe/architecture/
- Repository: https://github.com/mcpware/IntentProbe
- Models: https://huggingface.co/mcpware
- Probe catalog: https://github.com/mcpware/IntentProbe/tree/main/probes
- Manuscript: https://github.com/mcpware/IntentProbe/blob/main/research/multitask-activation-benchmark/paper/DRAFT.md
